evidence.reason: The supplied proof only checks that the record completions have two distinct invocations and that each journal sequence is an int above the pre-switch maximum. It never calls validate_completed(..., unit=REPAIR_UNIT) or compares each completion's sequence with the corresponding final-log entry; the later loop at 2549-2555 checks only invocation membership/exclusion. Thus a reversed invocation order or a journal/log sequence mismatch still passes, which is the reported defect.
